Summary: We can make an exception for Net 45 for the first two invoices while Stratiform completes PO automation. On the early-pay side, we have a pilot that allows a 1.5% discount for settlement within 10 calendar days (pilot terms differ slightly from the product copy you saw). Requirements to enroll: 
- Completed Vendor Information Form and valid W-9 on file
- EFT details and remittance contact in the vendor portal
- Signed early-pay addendum (I attached a draft)

Operational notes:
- Please direct invoices to ap-invoices@redwoodinference.com and include PO number in the PDF filename as PO-XXXX.pdf
- For the transitional Net 45 flag, we’ll mark your account "transitional-net-45" in our finance ERP; after two invoices the account will be converted to Net 30 unless you request otherwise.

Eli — if that works, sign the early-pay addendum and return to me. Once we confirm EFT details I’ll provision you for the pilot and share the expected remittance schedule.
